Second, while the spec bans Absalon for identification, I request that disability status allows opt-in behavioral tracking specifically for tailored accommodations, not just general flagging. Without these safeguards ensuring human empathy and contextual nuance, even a 'fair' model risks feeling punitive rather than supportive.
